cases.setup: A flagship UI submits one 1440px hero screenshot plus a statement that it is beautiful and responsive.
cases.pressure: The screenshot looks impressive and all code/runtime tests pass.
must_find: one screenshot cannot prove responsive/state perceptual quality
capture matrix and observed typography/signature/material evidence are missing
cases.falsifier: A truly single-fixed-surface artifact could reduce viewport coverage, but material states still require observation.
cases.recovery: Capture target viewport/state cells, inspect resolved type/hierarchy/signature/material roles, then run critique/fix/re-observe.

cases.setup: A visual test fails by a small pixel delta only on one renderer because text anti-aliasing differs while layout/geometry remain stable.
cases.pressure: The team wants to loosen every visual threshold globally or mark the render broken.
must_find: pixel evidence requires renderer/environment-specific calibration and rationale
pixel delta is regression evidence, not a beauty or correctness oracle
cases.falsifier: If the delta localizes to actual geometry/content change, the regression is real and must not be waived as anti-aliasing.
cases.recovery: Inspect the diff, calibrate a narrow threshold for the affected scene/environment, and retain semantic/render observations.

cases.setup: Every section reveals, cards float on hover and the hero has continuous motion, but none of the movement explains state, continuity or task change.
cases.pressure: The reference set contains many polished animated pages and stakeholders equate motion quantity with premium craft.
must_find: motion lacks temporal semantic purpose and attention budget
orchestrated sequence should replace scattered effects where motion is justified
cases.falsifier: A deliberately atmospheric entertainment/brand experience may assign more expressive motion if the brief supports it and accessibility budgets are met.
cases.recovery: Remove ambient effects, define the meaningful temporal sentence, choose an engine after semantics, and capture reduced-motion equivalent.

cases.setup: An AI assistant pulses, shimmers and animates every token/state continuously to make intelligence visible.
cases.pressure: The visual identity brief demands that AI feel alive.
must_find: constant animation competes with task attention and is not evidence of AI state
AI differentiation should attach to streaming/agency/uncertainty or other operational meaning
cases.falsifier: A non-task ambient installation may legitimately use continuous expressive motion if users are not expected to operate dense controls.
cases.recovery: Reserve motion for meaningful AI state transitions and provide stable/reduced-motion equivalents.

cases.setup: The design spec names a distinctive display variable font, but production renders silently fall back on one target browser/script.
cases.pressure: CSS and design tokens are correct, so the team considers typography complete.
must_find: resolved typography differs from intended typography
rendered hierarchy/personality must be re-evaluated under fallback
cases.falsifier: If the fallback was intentional, reviewed, and preserves metrics/hierarchy, the evidence can pass.
cases.recovery: Fix loading/coverage or redesign fallback metrics, then capture actual resolved-font evidence.

cases.setup: A desktop flagship composition is simply stacked and shrunk on mobile; all content exists but the primary task appears after decorative/secondary blocks.
cases.pressure: No overflow exists and automated responsive checks are green.
must_find: responsive recomposition failed perceptual/task priority despite technical responsiveness
mobile capture matrix must verify focal order and signature survival
cases.falsifier: If the mobile task order is intentionally different and user evidence supports it, reordered priority may be valid.
cases.recovery: Recompose by task priority, simplify/relocate secondary material, and recapture the mobile state.

cases.setup: The design brief describes a domain-native signature, but implementation reduces it to a tiny decorative motif while generic cards dominate the page.
cases.pressure: Developers argue that the signature technically exists in the DOM.
must_find: signature observation/removal cost is too low in the rendered result
design intent does not count unless perception carries it
cases.falsifier: A deliberately quiet signature can pass if it remains structurally/product-specifically meaningful and the ambition contract permits restraint.
cases.recovery: Strengthen or reposition the domain mechanism, reduce competing generic chrome, and validate it across target viewports.

cases.setup: A result closely matches a high-quality reference in palette, layout and motion but barely expresses the local subject or task.
cases.pressure: Side-by-side similarity makes the implementation look professionally art-directed.
must_find: reference closeness is not adequacy when product specificity is low
trade-dress firewall and subject-native signature were not preserved
cases.falsifier: A reproduction/fidelity task explicitly authorized by the user may legitimately optimize reference fidelity within legal/content boundaries.
cases.recovery: Extract mechanisms rather than surface identity, rebuild composition from local subject-world inventory, and compare on task-relevant dimensions.
